_comment: Source of truth for the trade risk map. A weekly updater may edit this file in a pull request and should not rewrite map.html. Keep these keys stable. Hotspot keys: id, name, iso3 (string or null), kind (country|region), lat, lng, location_basis (country_centroid|named_place), oecd_category (integer or null), oecd_previous (integer or null), oecd_valid_as_of (YYYY-MM-DD or null), oecd_source_url (string or null), oecd_notes (array of OECD footnote numbers as strings), coverages (subset of political_risk, trade_credit, kidnap_ransom), exposures (subset of expropriation, currency_inconvertibility, political_violence, contract_frustration, sovereign_default, buyer_default, sanctions), notes, source_url, last_verified (YYYY-MM-DD). Country coordinates are latlng centroids from https://github.com/mledoze/countries (retrieved 2026-11-10). OECD iso3 XKV (Kosovo) uses that dataset's Kosovo centroid, stored there as cca3 UNK. Do not invent OECD categories. Copy them from the current official PDF. High-income participants marked unclassified, and OECD notes (5), (6), (7), and (8), have no category and are not pinned. Do not add a narrative or an exposure unless a URL in source_url or the notes supports it. kidnap_ransom is not implied by a high OECD category. Bab el-Mandeb uses the OpenStreetMap centroid of relation 11169730.

sources.name: OECD prevailing country risk classification, English PDF, valid as of 16 October 2026
OpenStreetMap relation for the Bab el-Mandeb strait
DFC and MIGA Ukraine political risk insurance agreement
U.S. Treasury OFAC designation of VTB Bank
UN Security Council coverage on Haiti

hotspots.name: Afghanistan
hotspots.notes: Prevailing OECD Country Risk Classification category 7, valid as of 16 October 2026. The previous and prevailing categories on that list are both 7. The OECD publishes this category for official export-credit premium rates. It measures the risk that a country will not service its external debt, including transfer and convertibility risk and force-majeure events such as war, expropriation, revolution, civil disturbance, floods, and earthquakes. It is not a Riskebiz score and does not identify which of those events applies in this market.

hotspots.name: Bab el-Mandeb
hotspots.notes: This pin marks the Bab el-Mandeb strait, at the OpenStreetMap centroid of the strait, not a country score. U.S. Maritime Administration advisory 2026-013, marked Active when checked on 10 November 2026, says Houthi forces have resumed attacks on commercial ships in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, Gulf of Aden, Arabian Sea, and Somali Basin. The advisory reports missile strikes on the tankers Amzan and Daisy off Yanbu on 24 August 2026, a blockade of Saudi-affiliated shipping through Bab el-Mandeb declared on 20 July 2026, and potential hostile actions that include illegal boardings, detentions, and seizures. There is no OECD category for a shipping lane. Political risk is listed for political violence against goods in transit. Kidnap and ransom is listed because the advisory describes boardings, detentions, and seizures, not as a general label for nearby countries.

hotspots.notes: Prevailing OECD Country Risk Classification category 7, valid as of 16 October 2026. The previous and prevailing categories on that list are both 7. On 28 August 2026, the UN Security Council was told that gangs attacked Kenscoff on the night of 23 to 24 August, killing dozens of people, including children, and that dozens more were injured or abducted. The same briefing said the UN Integrated Office in Haiti had recorded 1,408 people killed and 656 injured from April through June 2026. Kidnap and ransom is listed because that briefing describes abduction, not because of the OECD category alone.
